verdict.rationale: Docs say the OCR processor accepts images and PDFs and works "even from low-quality or handwritten sources." Hands-on reports back this up: users describe it as very impressive on severely degraded 55-year-old paper files, ahead of Abbyy, and highly accurate on handwritten forms. One tester saw a whole page returned as a single image instead of text, a real but isolated failure that tempers confidence. Missing for 10: any evidence on skewed or rotated pages, any evidence on stamps or seals, and documentation of how photographed (camera) inputs are handled.
